study_type_evidence.quote: The validated method was applied to quantify the concentrations of AWRK6 in rat plasma.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: SPF-grade male Sprague Dawley, 280-320 g, 8 weeks
in_vivo_species.quote: SPF-grade male Sprague Dawley rats (280-320 g, 8 weeks old) were purchased from Liaoning Changsheng Biotechology

agents.name: AWRK6 (intraperitoneal, 2.35 mg/kg)
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body; sequence is PEPlife2's and was not verifiable from the text.
agents.dose_route_quote: the rats was administrated with AWRK6 dissolved in saline intraperitoneally at 2.35, 4.7, and 9.4 mg/kg bodyweight and intravenously at 4.7 mg/kg
agents.tmax: 1.167-1.250 h after i.p.; not applicable for i.v.
agents.pk_quote: The pharmacokinetic parameters of AWRK6 were listed in Table 3. The absolute bioavailability of AWRK6 was about 50% at the 3 doses.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: The mean plasma concentrations of AWRK6 in rats following single intraperitoneal injection of AWRK6 at 2.35, 4.7 and 9.4 mg/kg bodyweight were shown in Figure 3A
concentration_time_figure.note: Two-compartment model fitted with a weight coefficient of 1.

bioanalytical_method: Validated LC-MS/MS of rat plasma; parameters computed in DAS 2.0
bioanalytical_quote: The obtained data were analyzed using DAS 2.0 software (Anhui Provincial Center for Drug Clinical Evaluation).
notes: All four PEPlife2 values verified exactly against the t1/2z row of Table 3: 2.946 ± 2.048 (i.p. 2.35), 2.941 ± 1.399 (i.p. 4.7), 2.781 ± 1.021 (i.p. 9.4) and 1.983 ± 0.583 h (i.v. 4.7 mg/kg). PEPlife2 records no route, so the three i.p. values and the one i.v. value are indistinguishable in the database; the i.v. value is the true elimination half-life while the i.p. values are flip-flop-prone (absorption-rate-limited), which is consistent with the i.p. t1/2 being ~50% longer. Note the SD on the lowest i.p. dose (±2.048 on 2.946 h) is nearly 70% of the mean. The body does not print the peptide sequence.
